blurb:
Which animal kills the most people? Not the shark. Meatball ranks the deadliest animals on Earth by how many people they actually kill: sharks (about nine a year), the kissing bug that bites your face while you sleep, the dog (rabies), the snake that warns you by sizzling, and the tiny winner that kills more than half a million people a year.

Which animal are you most scared of? Best answer gets read out next time 👇

beats.say: One animal kills more than half a million people every year. Sharks? About ten. I'll show you the winner at the end. You've almost certainly met one.
Quick one before we start. Last time I asked which extinct animal you'd bring back. If you haven't answered yet, go tell me. I read them all, and the best one gets read out on the show.
beats.text:
WHICH ONE
WOULD YOU
BRING BACK?

beats.say: I'm Meatball. I narrate nature. Nature, frankly, keeps trying to eat me. Today: the deadliest animals on Earth, ranked by how many people they actually kill. Smallest number first.
Starting with the one everybody's scared of.
Sharks kill fewer people than you think. In 2025, the whole world had nine unprovoked fatal shark bites. Nine.
beats.chapter: Sharks: the one you're scared of
beats.loop_say: Nine. In a whole year. So remember,
beats.short_title: Sharks Kill Way Fewer People Than You Think 🦈
beats.bonus: Scientists log every confirmed bite worldwide; most years see somewhere between five and ten unprovoked deaths.
beats.comment: Still going in the water? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: Scientists count every confirmed bite. Most years, it's somewhere between five and ten deaths. Worldwide.
So the ocean's most famous killer is, statistically, not very good at it.
Still going in the water? Comment.
Meanwhile, people kill tens of millions of sharks every year. So, honestly. Who should be scared of whom?
Quick thing. If watching a meatball rank everything that could eat him is your idea of fun, subscribing genuinely keeps me off the menu. That's how it works. I checked.
What about the big scary ones? Lions. Hippos. Crocodiles. They do kill people. But none of them come anywhere near the top of this list.
Because the top of the list is small. Some of it fits on your fingertip.
This bug bites people on the face while they sleep. It's called the kissing bug.
beats.short_title: The Bug That Bites Your Face While You Sleep 🪲
beats.bonus: Kissing bugs live mostly in Latin America, and some kinds live in the southern United States.
beats.comment: Would you sleep with the light on? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: It hides in cracks in the walls by day, and drinks your blood at night.
The real danger is its poop, which can carry a parasite. The disease it causes kills more than ten thousand people a year.
It's part of the assassin bug family. Which is a lot of branding, for a bug that wins by pooping.
Here's how. It bites near your mouth or eyes, then poops right next to the bite. You scratch in your sleep, and rub the parasite in.
The disease is called Chagas. About eight million people have it, mostly in Latin America, and many don't know, because it can stay quiet for years.
Something that sneaks up while you're asleep and eats. That's my entire fear, in one bug.
beats.aside: (I sleep with one eye open. I have two.)

beats.say: The next animal on the list is probably asleep on somebody's couch right now.
Dogs kill far more people than sharks. Tens of thousands a year. But not with their teeth.
beats.loop_say: Your dog loves you. But remember,
beats.short_title: Dogs Kill More People Than Sharks. Here's How 🐕
beats.bonus: If an animal bites you, wash the wound with soap and water for about 15 minutes and get medical help fast.
beats.comment: Is your dog vaccinated? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: It's rabies, a virus spread by bites and scratches. Dogs cause nearly every human case.
Once symptoms start, it's almost always fatal. But a vaccine soon after the bite stops it.
Is your dog vaccinated? Tell me.
Around four in ten of the people who die are children. Almost all of it happens in Asia and Africa, where many dogs aren't vaccinated.
The fix is boring, and it works. Vaccinate the dogs, and the people stop dying. If an animal ever bites you, wash it with soap and water for fifteen minutes, then get the shots. Fast.
In 2015, the world set a goal: zero people dying of rabies from dogs by 2030. It's called Zero by Thirty. Catchy. Slightly terrifying.
Also, dogs love meatballs. I'm not saying that's related. I'm just saying it's on my mind.
If that one surprised you, hit like, so I know to keep the scary ones coming. The dogs are fine with it. I asked.
Snakes kill somewhere between eighty and a hundred and forty thousand people every year.
In India alone, scientists estimate about fifty eight thousand snakebite deaths a year. Most happen in villages, far from a hospital.
This snake warns you with a sound like sizzling. It rubs its scales together.
beats.short_title: This Snake Warns You by Sizzling 🐍
beats.bonus: The saw-scaled viper is one of India's 'Big Four', the snakes behind most serious bites there.
beats.comment: Would you hear it coming? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: It's the saw-scaled viper. Small, and one of India's Big Four, the snakes behind most deadly bites there.
Sizzling. Of all the sounds.
Would you hear it coming? Comment.
And for every person a snake kills, about three more lose a limb, or are hurt for life. Most of them are farmers and children.
Antivenom works. But it has to reach you fast, and in a lot of places it doesn't. In 2017, the World Health Organization added snakebite to its list of neglected tropical diseases.
India's Big Four are the cobra, the krait, Russell's viper and the saw-scaled viper. Sounds like a band. A band I would not see live.
Let's check the scoreboard. Sharks: nine. The kissing bug: ten thousand. Dogs: tens of thousands. Snakes: more than eighty thousand. Number one isn't even close.
The deadliest animal in the world is the mosquito. In 2024, malaria alone killed about six hundred thousand people.
beats.short_title: The Deadliest Animal on Earth Is Tiny 🦟
beats.bonus: Malaria is spread by some female Anopheles mosquitoes; about 95% of cases and deaths are in Africa.
beats.comment: How many did you swat this year? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: Most of them were children under five, in Africa.
And it weighs less than a grain of rice. I've been worried about the wrong animals my whole life.
Only the females bite. They need the blood to make their eggs. The males just drink nectar.
Malaria itself is a tiny parasite. The mosquito sucks it up from one person's blood, and injects it into the next.
A flying needle that drinks blood and follows your breath. I don't have blood. I have sauce. I'm still not comfortable.
A mosquito finds you by smelling the carbon dioxide in your breath, from metres away. Then it follows your heat, and your smell.
beats.short_title: Mosquitoes Find You by Smelling Your Breath 🦟
beats.bonus: Female mosquitoes sense carbon dioxide with special organs near their mouthparts.
beats.comment: Why do they always pick you? 👇 Follow Meatball for more 🍝

beats.say: So, technically, every breath you take is an invitation. Including that one.
Why do they always pick you? Comment.
And malaria is just one disease. Other mosquitoes, like this one, spread dengue, yellow fever and Zika.
Here's the twist I promised. The mosquito isn't deadly on its own. What it carries is. Same with the dog. Same with the bug.
The good news: bed nets, medicine and new malaria vaccines save lives every year. Slowly, we're winning.
So here's the final list. Sharks, nine. The kissing bug, ten thousand. Dogs, tens of thousands. Snakes, around a hundred thousand. Mosquitoes, more than half a million.
The lesson? The scariest animals aren't the big ones with teeth. They're the small ones nobody looks at twice.
For the record, the official list of animals that eat meatballs grew by one today. The dog. I'm not angry. I'm just noting it.
Last episode it was rats. Now dogs. At this rate, the list will need its own episode.
Now your turn. Which animal are you most scared of? Be honest. Best answer gets read out next time.
